description: This file defines a BackupService class for handling backup and restore operations of notes in an Android app, including notification management and coroutine-based background tasks.

classes.name: BackupService
classes.description: A foreground service managing backup and restore of notes, with notification updates and coroutine jobs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and notification manager.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, initiating restore or backup based on intent extras.

methods.name: onTimeout
methods.description: Cancels ongoing jobs and stops the service on timeout.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels lifecycle scope jobs when service is destroyed.

methods.name: startJob
methods.description: Launches a coroutine job and manages its completion.

methods.name: backupNotes
methods.description: Performs backup of notes, showing notifications for progress, success, or failure.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores notes from a backup URI, with notification updates.
